body.condition: For every nondegenerate \(a\in\mathbb R^K\), the Li--Ding maximum-squared-deviation condition holds for the fixed potential contributions \(\sum_{k=1}^{K}a_k\mathbf 1\{z\in\mathcal S_k\}\{W_{C,c}(z)-\mu_z\}/r_{C,k}\).
